field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this AmneziaWG server instance. The server is started on Apply when the global AmneziaWG service is enabled.

field.label: Name
field.help: Unique server name, max 15 chars

field.label: Interface Number
field.help: Creates awgN. Number must be free across clients and servers.

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: UDP port accepted by this server

field.label: Clients Endpoint
field.help: Provisioning-only public endpoint used when generating client QR codes and .conf files, e.g. vpn.example.com:4433. It is never written to the server runtime config.

field.label: Clients Keepalive
field.help: Provisioning-only PersistentKeepalive for generated clients. Accepts 0-65535 or an AWG 3.1 range such as 20-30; default is 25. It is never written to the server runtime config.

field.label: Clients DNS
field.help: Optional DNS server addresses written to generated client configurations. Multiple addresses may be separated by commas.

field.label: Tunnel Address
field.help: Server-side tunnel address, e.g. 10.8.1.1/24

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional note for this server. It is shown only in the OPNsense UI and is not written to the AmneziaWG runtime configuration.

field.label: Private Key
field.help: Stored outside config.xml. Use Generate Keypair for a new server.

field.label: MTU
field.help: MTU for the server tunnel interface. Leave empty to use the plugin default; lower it only when the path requires a smaller packet size.

field.label: Jc
field.help: Number of junk packets sent before each handshake (1-128). Generated clients inherit this server value.

field.label: Jmin
field.help: Minimum junk packet size in bytes. Must be compatible with Jmax; generated clients inherit this value.

field.label: Jmax
field.help: Maximum junk packet size in bytes. Must be greater than or equal to Jmin; generated clients inherit this value.

field.label: S1
field.help: Extra bytes added before the handshake initiation message. Generated clients must use the same value.

field.label: S2
field.help: Extra bytes added before the handshake response message. Generated clients must use the same value.

field.label: S3
field.help: Extra bytes added before the cookie message (0-1280). Generated clients must use the same value.

field.label: S4
field.help: Extra bytes added before transport data messages (0-1280). Generated clients must use the same value.

field.label: H1
field.help: Header ID for init packets. Accepts 1-4294967295 or a non-overlapping range; official default is 1.

field.label: H2
field.help: Header ID for response packets. Accepts 1-4294967295 or a non-overlapping range; official default is 2.

field.label: H3
field.help: Header ID for cookie packets. Accepts 1-4294967295 or a non-overlapping range; official default is 3.

field.label: H4
field.help: Header ID for data packets. Accepts 1-4294967295 or a non-overlapping range; official default is 4.

field.label: Header Protection Key
field.help: Optional 32-byte Base64 header-protection key. It is propagated to generated client configurations.

field.label: Content Padding Addition
field.help: Optional AWG 3.1 unsigned value or inclusive range, e.g. 64 or 32-96. Leave blank for the protocol default.

field.label: Rekey After Time
field.help: Optional AWG 3.1 timer value or inclusive range, e.g. 120 or 120-180. Leave blank for the protocol default.

field.label: Rekey Timeout
field.help: Optional AWG 3.1 timer value or inclusive range, e.g. 5 or 5-8. Leave blank for the protocol default.

field.label: Reject After Time
field.help: Optional AWG 3.1 timer value or inclusive range. Leave blank for the protocol default.

field.label: Keepalive Timeout
field.help: Optional AWG 3.1 timer value or inclusive range. Leave blank for the protocol default.

field.label: Max Handshake Attempts
field.help: Optional AWG 3.1 handshake-attempt count or inclusive range. Leave blank for the protocol default.

field.label: Random Trailers
field.help: On/off option. Checked = on, unchecked = off; no manual value entry. Enable randomized packet trailers and propagate the setting to generated clients.

field.label: Disable Cookies
field.help: On/off option. Checked = on, unchecked = off; no manual value entry. Disable cookie replies and propagate the setting to generated clients.

field.label: I1
field.help: CPS initiation-packet template using tags such as <b 0xHEX>, <r N>, <rd N>, <rc N>, <t> and <c>. Leave empty to disable CPS.

field.label: I2
field.help: Optional CPS packet 2 template. It is used only when I1 is configured; generated clients inherit it.

field.label: I3
field.help: Optional CPS packet 3 template. It is used only when I1 is configured; generated clients inherit it.

field.label: I4
field.help: Optional CPS packet 4 template. It is used only when I1 is configured; generated clients inherit it.

field.label: I5
field.help: Optional CPS packet 5 template. It is used only when I1 is configured; generated clients inherit it.
